verdict.falsifier: EvictionRecord.attribution distinguishes evictions that `b` decided from evictions that `b` did not.
verdict.detail: attribution carries '+b' on 1.0000 of evictions in every b_enabled=True arm including gamma_b = 0.0, where b is identically zero and changes 0.0000 of victims. Two of the four confusion cells are empty in every arm and every seed; I(token ; b-changed-victim) = 0.0000 bits with H(b-changed-victim) > 0 at every gamma_b > 0. The same holds for '-nu'. The instrument reports its own configuration, not its own effect.
